# SEO checklist — getting found

Everything that makes a search engine able to find you, understand you and rank you. Work top to bottom; the groups are ordered by return on effort for an independent restaurant.

Work top to bottom. The groups are ordered by return on effort for an independent restaurant.

> Tick these off in the browser version at `index.html` if you would rather not print it —
> progress saves automatically. Items with an **AI** note have a matching prompt in
> [the prompt library](04-ai-prompt-library.md).

## 📍 Google Business Profile

Free, fast, and the highest-return work available to a restaurant. Do this group first even if you do nothing else.

- [ ] Claim and verify your Google Business Profile  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Confirm there is only one profile for this location — search Maps for old addresses too  
  <sub>⏱ 5 min</sub>
- [ ] Set the most specific accurate primary category  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Pick the right Google category**</sub>
- [ ] Add two to five secondary categories for genuine secondary services  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Set correct regular hours  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Add special hours for every holiday and closure in the next twelve months  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Add more-hours entries for kitchen close, brunch, happy hour, delivery  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Complete every applicable attribute: seating, service options, parking, payments, accessibility  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] Set dietary attributes — vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free, halal, kosher  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Write the 750-character business description  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Write the 750-character business description**</sub>
- [ ] Upload 20+ photos covering exterior, interior, bar, patio, 10 dishes, team  
  <sub>⏱ 2 hours</sub>
- [ ] Load your full menu into the profile with sections, descriptions and prices  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour</sub>
- [ ] Set menu, order and reservation links to pages you control  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Tap every button on your live profile from a phone and confirm where it lands  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Seed and answer ten entries in the Q&A section  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Seed your Google Q&A section**</sub>
- [ ] Add your opening date and, if you have one, a short video  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] Publish Google Posts at least twice a month  
  <sub>⏱ ongoing  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Draft a month of Google Posts in one sitting**</sub>
- [ ] Add new photos every week  
  <sub>⏱ ongoing</sub>

## 🧱 Website foundations

It does not need to be beautiful. It needs to be fast, readable by machines, and easy to act on.

- [ ] Own a website on your own domain, not only a social page or delivery storefront  
  <sub>⏱ varies</sub>
- [ ] Install SSL and force all traffic to one canonical HTTPS version  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Get mobile load time under three seconds  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Translate a PageSpeed report into a work order**</sub>
- [ ] Compress every image under 200KB and remove autoplay video from the landing page  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour</sub>
- [ ] Put name, address, phone and hours as selectable text in the footer of every page  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] Make the phone number a tap-to-call link  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Put Order and Reserve buttons above the fold and in a sticky header  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Write a unique title tag for every page, including your city or neighborhood  
  <sub>⏱ 45 min</sub>
- [ ] Write a meta description for every page  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Verify the site in Google Search Console and submit a sitemap  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Check the Search Console Pages report for anything wrongly excluded  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] Confirm the site is indexed with a site: search  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] Add descriptive alt text to every food and interior photo  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>

## 🍽️ Menu and content

If your menu is a PDF, the first item here is the most valuable hour in this entire document.

- [ ] Rebuild the menu as real HTML text — not a PDF, not an image  
  <sub>⏱ 2 hours  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Turn a photographed menu into a real web page**</sub>
- [ ] Write a description with ingredients and method for every dish  
  <sub>⏱ 2 hours  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Write dish descriptions that match how people search**</sub>
- [ ] Show prices on the menu page  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Tag dishes for vegetarian, vegan, gluten-free and allergens — verified by the kitchen  
  <sub>⏱ 45 min</sub>
- [ ] Build a Visit page with parking, transit, landmarks and accessibility  
  <sub>⏱ 2 hours  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Research your neighborhood for a location page**</sub>
- [ ] Write an About page naming the owner, the chef and your sourcing  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour</sub>
- [ ] Build a private events or catering page if you offer either  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour</sub>
- [ ] Add a specials or events page and keep it current  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Build a twelve-month content calendar  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Build a 12-month content calendar**</sub>
- [ ] Update the website the same day the kitchen changes the menu  
  <sub>⏱ ongoing</sub>

## ⭐ Reviews

Volume, velocity and responses. Build the ask into the shift rather than running campaigns.

- [ ] Write the review-ask messages for check drop, receipt email and follow-up text  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Write the review request messages**</sub>
- [ ] Put a Google review QR code on the check presenter  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Add a review link to your booking and order confirmation messages  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] Brief the team on how and when to ask — and never to gate by mood  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] Reply to every review, positive and negative, within a few days  
  <sub>⏱ ongoing  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Draft a reply to a hard review**</sub>
- [ ] Claim your Yelp, TripAdvisor and Facebook review profiles  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Set up alerts for new reviews across all platforms  
  <sub>⏱ 15 min</sub>
- [ ] Run a theme analysis on your last 100 reviews  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Mine your reviews for what to fix and what to promote**</sub>
- [ ] Fix the operational issue your reviews complain about most  
  <sub>⏱ ongoing</sub>

## 🗂️ Listings and consistency

Boring but load-bearing. One wrong phone number on a big directory costs covers every week.

- [ ] Write down one canonical version of your name, address and phone  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Build your directory checklist**</sub>
- [ ] Claim Apple Business Connect  
  <sub>⏱ 45 min</sub>
- [ ] Claim Bing Places  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Update Yelp, TripAdvisor and Facebook to the canonical details  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Update every delivery and reservation platform you use  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Search your phone number in quotes and fix every mismatch you find  
  <sub>⏱ 45 min</sub>
- [ ] Find and report duplicate listings for merging  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour</sub>
- [ ] Get listed by the chamber of commerce and local tourism board  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Pitch local food writers and neighborhood publications  
  <sub>⏱ ongoing  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Draft a pitch to a local food writer**</sub>

## 🏷️ Structured data

The part where AI genuinely writes the code for you. Validate everything before publishing.

- [ ] Generate Restaurant JSON-LD for the homepage  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Generate Restaurant schema markup**</sub>
- [ ] Validate it in the Rich Results Test and fix every error  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min  ·  🤖 AI prompt: **Fix schema validation errors**</sub>
- [ ] Add the validated block to the head of your homepage  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Add Menu and MenuItem schema to the menu page  
  <sub>⏱ 1 hour</sub>
- [ ] Add FAQPage schema to the FAQ page  
  <sub>⏱ 30 min</sub>
- [ ] Include a sameAs array listing every profile you own  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] Add openingHoursSpecification rather than free-text hours  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
- [ ] Confirm you are not marking up your own aggregate review rating  
  <sub>⏱ 10 min</sub>
- [ ] Add Event schema if you host ticketed or recurring events  
  <sub>⏱ 20 min</sub>
